snippet.title: Fracture Field - An Incremental Quarry Management Game
snippet.description:
It begins with a single stone. Welcome to Fracture Field, a new incremental mining game where strategic management and explosive growth go hand-in-hand.

Master the satisfying rhythm of your swing to break through ever-tougher layers of rock, from humble clay to brilliant diamonds. Every hit earns you resources, and every shattered rock yields valuable Dust to fuel your progression.

But raw power isn't enough. Invest your earnings into a massive web of upgrades for your tools, drones, and each individual rock layer. Build and command a fleet of specialized drones to automate your empire, and use powerful, charge-based bombs to clear your path. In Fracture Field, your old discoveries become the engine for your future growth.

This is the first look at gameplay for my passion project, and I'm so excited to share it with you!

Wishlist on Steam Coming Soon!

Play on itch.io:
https://type-ten.itch.io/fracture-field
